title: seeFinancialData ON for a system-tech user (regression test for legacy 'Time Clock saw pricing' bug)
preconds: Build with CRP-BE-09 deployed. Test user on system-tech (seeFinancialData=OFF per tech plan §3c).
steps:
1. Authenticate as test user.
2. Hit GET on every endpoint a tech can reach: WOs, WO lines, schedule, customers (view only).
3. Inspect each response for pricing keys.
4. Also hit any PDF endpoints reachable by Tech.
expected: ZERO pricing data anywhere in any payload. The legacy bug does not recur.
